description: A drug company's pipeline, no key: active clinical trials by phase, the readouts (primary completions) due in the coming months, late-stage trials, and its FDA approvals, from ClinicalTrials.gov and Drugs@FDA.

company.description: Ticker, CIK or name; its SEC name is searched.

months.description: Readouts: primary completions due within this many months; default 12.

sponsor.description: Or the sponsor name as trials list it, e.g. "Vertex Pharmaceuticals".

name: drug_pipeline

outputSchema.description: Each table's rows in the order of its columns; readouts by primary completion date.
